### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues block the Unicode string-length validation change. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR aligns generated plan-time string validation in the AWS Cloud Control provider with JSON Schema’s Unicode character counts rather than byte counts, addressing the non-ASCII validation problem reported in #3301. **Changes:** - Replaces byte-based string validators with `UTF8LengthAtLeast`, `UTF8LengthAtMost`, and `UTF8LengthBetween`, preserving numeric bounds. -
